tests.evidence: At 433a9ed (6e6e0df is docs only): all nine docs/benchmark/*-fixtures/run-tests.sh suites exit 0; git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 shellcheck -S warning exits 0. Harness validated with real codex runs after the final changes: template build with baseline 197/289; native and SOP task-05 runs valid; judge and re-judge (skipped by packet hash) exit 0; an invalid stub archived to invalid/ with its auth copy removed; a SOP run reaching 1800 s recorded exit 142 timed_out true with its process group killed; report on the committed R6 folder reproduces identical judge columns; no auth.json copies remain. validate-state-transitions OK.

findings.message: Fixed (was HIGH, below block_on): agent-writable .git could plant config executed by harness git calls; hgit hardening, .git/config restore, hooks and info removal.
Fixed (was MEDIUM): operator environment inherited by codex, npm test and judge; now env -i with PATH/HOME/CODEX_HOME/TERM/LANG only.
Fixed (was MEDIUM): login copies persisted in run homes; umask 077, install -m 600, deleted after each exec and by EXIT trap, removed before archiving.
npm test runs agent-written code on the host outside the Codex sandbox. Accepted residual; stated in the header.
Login copies could rotate refresh tokens. Mitigated by warming the main login first; main login confirmed working after R6. Accepted.
Hooks inside the writable workspace run under --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust; sandboxed. Accepted.
.git subpaths other than config, hooks and info could be replaced by symlinks. Accepted.
Archived attempts keep the agent-written proj/.git; harness never runs git there. Accepted.
Judge overall 0.70 disagreed with its criteria mean 0.60. Fixed: overall recomputed from marks in all files (model_overall kept); summary task 07 row and delta corrected; harness computes scores.
Baseline stated as 212/305; corrected to 197/289 at 814b3b5.
Archived invalid runs matched runs/* globs. Fixed: archives under <out>/invalid/.
Native arm keeps project docs beyond Backlog.md. Disclosed in Limits.
valid definition wording; fixed in 6e6e0df.
Commit list; fixed in 6e6e0df.
Fixed (BLOCK round 645fae2, was HIGH): set -e inert inside one_run; each run now a separate process.
Fixed (was HIGH): unrun suites read as 0 failures; count_tests returns null, report shows exits and pass counts.
Fixed (was HIGH): failed codex runs recorded as normal results; valid flag, invalid runs skipped by judge and archived.
Fixed (was MEDIUM): suite-broken and timed-out runs were classed invalid and retried, biasing toward the arm that breaks or stalls; now scored as results.
Report summary does not count timed-out runs per arm (column shows them). Accepted.
Older-version judge scores are shown with a stderr warning; needed for the frozen R6 folder. Accepted.
A timed-out run can be valid with NA usage, excluded from token sums. Accepted; NA shown.
